description: The canon override — grant-then-write, ledger-first (COMP-CANON-GUARD Decision 4, deferred at S4 and never built). canon_override_grant({path, reason, operation}) MCP tool: rejects empty/whitespace reason, writes the ledger entry BEFORE minting, token is single-use and path-scoped so the override costs something visible rather than decaying into 'turn the guard off'. Blocks COMP-CANON-ATTEST, which needs a governed reconcile path for a chain break. Must also answer the ledger circularity: an authorization written into ledger.jsonl breaks the very chain it authorizes, so ledger-drift recovery needs a bootstrap route outside the attested set.

links.note: Decision 4; specified in the epic, explicitly deferred at S4, never built
